items.prompt: Use-case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. EDIT the provided game UI screenshot, revision A2, into A3 EDGE COMMAND STRIP. The single input is the edit target. Preserve the exact isometric illustrated rust canyon, same camera, cream/teal buildings, four selected friendly units, yellow selection and cyan planned waypoint/path. No extra figures/buildings/terrain redesign. Preserve German text and restrained matte dark slate interface. There is NO game title or logo at upper left, keep it absent. The USER's precise layout corrections are mandatory: 1) THE COMMAND STRIP IS ATTACHED TO THE VERY BOTTOM SCREEN EDGE, with ZERO VISIBLE TERRAIN GAP under it, and STARTS AT THE EXTREME BOTTOM-LEFT CORNER x0, NOT centered at x300. Draw a shallow continuous slate strip from x0 along the bottom toward the right (may extend full width), about90-96 pixels high in this1672x941 frame, ending exactly at bottom y941. No rounded floating island with outer margins at bottom or left. The viewport is the image itself, do not add external device/frame. 2) COMPACT SQUARE COMMAND BUTTONS, not horizontal rectangles. Five equally sized small squares in a row from the LEFT: 'Bewegen', 'Nehmen', 'Verteidigen', 'Flankieren', then 'Plan ausführen' IMMEDIATELY TO THE RIGHT OF FLANKIEREN. The first four squares are command choices; the fifth is the separate execute action with cyan fill and a simple PLAY triangle. All five square bodies about54-56px by54-56px here, simple24px-ish icons, not giant tiles. Put readable German labels directly BELOW each square, outside the square body, in the bottom strip; allow generous label cell width, about90px per tile, so Verteidigen and Plan ausführen are not clipped and no miniature text is needed. No command label above the row, no big text inside the square that distorts aspect ratio. Primary execute is square, definitely NOT a long wide Plan ausführen rectangle. Do not conflate choosing an order with executing a plan, no pause/speed control. 3) Compact stance 'Vorsichtig · Normal · Aggressiv' (Normal selected), separate dropdown 'Feuer erwidern', selected context 'ALPHA4/4 · FTL Mara · Bereit', and short current-order dropdown 'Auftrag: Bewegen' / status 'Ziel gewählt' fit to the RIGHT of the five square actions inside the same shallow bottom strip. Use one slim status line plus compact controls, not a second huge panel. Preserve open breathing room for possible future context without inventing active buttons or placeholder words. 4) MOVE the LEFT ALPHA and BRAVO TEAM CARDS UPWARD, keeping their current readable size, faces, four members and yellow selection. Both team cards must sit ABOVE the bottom strip with a small visible vertical gap, never overlap it or prevent it from starting at x0. Their approximate combined region can be x12..284,y480..790; don't shift them right. 5) MOVE the small event/protocol panel UP on the right so it also sits just ABOVE the strip with a small gap, no overlap. Preserve its two event lines, e.g. 'ALPHA bereit für Befehl' and 'BRAVO hält Position'. 6) TOP-RIGHT DROPSHIP / LANDING CARD gets slightly MORE COMPACT than the input: smaller ship thumbnail and reduced padding, roughly20-25percent less height, keep clear 'Dropship · Bereit' status and 'Landezone wählen' control. Keep it in upper-right corner. The mission/assignment card 'Relais sichern' stays near UPPER-RIGHT-CENTER to the left of Dropship; keep it compact and legible. Do not move these to bottom. Retain same dark slate, off-white text, cyan interaction, yellow selected team. Text must remain readable; compactness comes from small square controls and reduced padding, not shrunken type. Any tiny 'UI-ENTWURF · BEISPIELWERTE' caption can be unobtrusive above the strip, never force a bottom margin. Entire screenshot composition stays1672x941 aspect. The key visible differences MUST be a bottomLEFT-flush edge band, FIVE SMALL SQUARE actions with execute directly after flank, teamcards/log moved UP, compact upper-right transport card.
